CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitMaskSet

Returns the number with length bits, starting at bit start, replaced by the low bits of mask. Bits outside that run are left alone.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitMaskSet(number, mask, start, length)

Parameters

number
A 32-bit integer to modify.
mask
The value to store. Only its lowest length bits are used.
start
Position of the lowest bit to write, 0 to 31.
length
Number of bits to write, 1 to 31.

Returns

An integer (signed 32-bit).

Usage

Think of it as BitMaskClear followed by a BitOr of the mask shifted into place. If the mask is too large for the field, the extra high bits are silently dropped.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Packed = 0>
<CFSET Packed = BitMaskSet(Packed, 31, 0, 5)>   <!--- day   --->
<CFSET Packed = BitMaskSet(Packed, 12, 5, 4)>   <!--- month --->
<CFSET Packed = BitMaskSet(Packed, 99, 9, 7)>   <!--- year - 1900 --->
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Packed date: #Packed# (binary <TT>#FormatBaseN(Packed, 2)#</TT>)
<P>Unpacked: #BitMaskRead(Packed, 5, 4)#/#BitMaskRead(Packed, 0, 5)#/#1900 + BitMaskRead(Packed, 9, 7)#
<P>Too big for the field: <TT>BitMaskSet(0, 255, 4, 3)</TT> = #BitMaskSet(0, 255, 4, 3)#
(only 3 bits, <TT>111</TT>, were stored)
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

BitMaskRead, BitMaskClear, BitOr, BitSHLN
